messages:
rachel: Heads-up: customer reported they were billed twice after a streaming session with a toolcall retried during a reconnect. trace: rv-21a

min: short timeline? provisional + confirmed or duplicate confirmed?

rachel: provisional written at accept (estimate 108 tokens). reconnect -> router swapped region and normalized headers, idempotency header lost, runtime retried toolcall -> confirmed 87 tokens. ledger shows both entries.

oli: so two faults: router stripping client idempotency header and ledger not reconciling provisional vs confirmed. billing dedupe only on runtime-generated request id.

sylvia: low-friction fix: router should generate a session_commit_id at ingress and attach X-Session-Commit to downstream requests. billing writes provisional with that id; runtime finalizes using same id. billing upsert by session_commit_id -> replace pending with final.

min: agree. console UX: surface "pending tokens" separate from invoiced, tooltip "may change on finalization", TTL and link to disputes. ops tile: pending->final delta metric and alert on spikes.

billing-bot: note: ledger change required: add pending bucket for provisional entries and new events billing.pending.created, billing.pending.finalized, billing.pending.expired. Migration plan needed for existing provisional entries.

oli: short-term mitigations: revert header-normalization in canary, runtime guard to reject toolcall replay if no idempotency header and no session_commit_id (fail fast), and add logging to trace session_commit_id across components.

sylvia: quotas: provisional should still reserve quota to prevent bursts. on finalization quota is decremented from pending and applied. sync with quota team before rollout.

min: owners: router#512 session-id-mint (@oli), billing#920 pending-ledger (@sylvia), console#403 pending-ui (@min), telemetry#121 session-commit-events (@oli). QA: add e2e cases: route-swap with header preserved, route-swap with header lost, model-fallback with token delta, truncated stream EOF vs reconnect.

rachel: thanks. I'll draft the billing design doc and open the router revert PR. ping when PRs are ready. :thumbsup:
